Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Pallavi Hegde. I am a 70-year-old electrician living in Kozhikode. Arjun Swamy has filed a police complaint against me over ₹7,75,000, and the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 93104 39888 or email pallavi.hegde@example.com.
